settings.heading: Why I hold circles
settings.text:
The first time I sat in a circle, at a women's retreat in Portugal, I didn't expect much. We drew cards, wrote in our journals, and listened to each other for an hour.

What the other women shared stayed with me. I heard my own questions in their stories, and I left feeling sure about the path I was on. I want people in Nebraska to have that same hour.

settings.quote: "It was simply sitting together, journaling, and listening to one another. The magic that comes from that community is life changing."
settings.context: On the women's circle in Portugal that started all of this.

settings.heading: What to bring
settings.text:
Comfortable clothes, a water bottle, and a journal if you have one. A blanket or pillow is nice. I'll bring the cacao, the mats, and the cups.

Each gathering runs about 90 minutes. Tickets are $35, cup included, and members come once a month at no charge.

If you're pregnant or nursing, have a heart condition, or take medications, please check with your provider before you come, and tell me when you arrive. I can serve you a lighter cup.

settings.heading: Host a private gathering
settings.text: For birthdays, teams, studio classes, or a few friends in your living room. I bring the cacao and guide the gathering.
What I'm learning about cacao, the next gathering, and the newest chapter of building the club. Your first block is 10% off when you join.
